title: 502 Bad Gateway
story: Users see 502 errors. Nginx is up, but the app behind it is not.
goal: Get http://shop.local/ back to 200 by starting the right service.

files./var/log/nginx/error.log: connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream 127.0.0.1:5000

hints: Read the nginx error log: which address was refused?
Port 5000 belongs to shop-app. Start it with systemctl.

Run:
curl -I http://shop.local/
cat /var/log/nginx/error.log
systemctl start shop-app
curl http://shop.local/
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
